note: Kosovo: a foreign citizen is employed on a work permit the employer applies for, with a stay permit under the Law on Foreigners; the exempt categories (diplomats, key company staff, lecturers, journalists, religious representatives and others) name no performers (Law No. 03/L-136, art. 13). No days without it.

sources.title: Law No. 03/L-136 on Granting Permit for Work and Employment of Foreign Citizens in the Republic of Kosovo
